title: Add a JSON output mode
summary: A new formatter module prints the counts as JSON and the argument parser selects it when the flag is present.

design_elements.title: Print counts as JSON
design_elements.responsibility: Formats the line, word and character counts as one JSON object when the flag is given.

decisions.title: Write the JSON by hand
decisions.choice: Build the JSON text with the standard library, because the tool has no dependencies and the output has three fields.
alternatives: Add a JSON library as a dependency.
decisions.consequences: No new dependency is needed, and the formatter must escape its own output.

risks: The argument parser may change the order of flags.
